title: CR-PAY-007 — WO pricing viewer
preconds: Permissions (counted): WO View + See Financial. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.

expected:
